title: crypto2dev: distro and CI validation
description: Validate that the crypto2dev shim builds cleanly and all tests pass across the Linux distro matrix supported by tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh. Covers: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (kernel 5.15), Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (kernel 6.8), Debian 12 (Bookworm), Rocky Linux 9, Fedora latest, Amazon Linux 2023, ARM64/Graviton. Also validates FIPS mode (Rocky 9 with fips-mode-setup, Ubuntu with Ubuntu Pro). Tracks first successful run on each distro and any distro-specific fixes required.
notes: Script: tests/ci/test-on-aws.sh with TEST_CRYPTO2DEV=1 TEST_LINUXKM=1. Each distro test is a separate issue under this epic. The epic is complete when all distros show a clean run. Depends on wolfssl-0h3 (implementation) and wolfssl-c62 (tests).
